entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 1696877570753454208: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 75097: distance 149.254 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.016), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 149.254 +/- 2.388 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 6.5959 +/- 0.2943 mas (same row, RUWE 4.68), 22.4 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -15.908, 17.146 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 1696877570753454208 (quality A), from 2006AstL...32..759G; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 16.408 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 75097: radius 16.408 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 998.14 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.058) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 8015 +/- 240 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 75097: effective temperature 8015 +/- 240 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.042).
